svg.title: راجِع
svg.desc: THE WORDMARK ITSELF, same rule as apps/console/public/favicon.svg (no drawn icon anywhere in the product since 2026-09-16) — found live: this file never existed, so Chrome's tab showed Flutter's own stock template mark instead. Colours are LITERAL, not a Dart constant: a favicon is fetched outside the Flutter app, so it has no access to AppColors.accent. #7C3AED is config/product.json's current brand.accent.light, read directly rather than copied from console's own favicon.svg (that file's #6a4cf5 is itself a stale, un-updated snapshot).
